items.title: Adobe Patches Magento Zero-Day Exploited to Deploy Rust Backdoor and PHP Web Shell
items.summary: Adobe on Monday released security patches to address a maximum-severity flaw impacting Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that has come under active exploitation in the wild. The vulnerability, now tracked as CVE-2026-75650 (CVSS score: 10.0), has been codenamed StyleSmuggler
items.author: Ravie Lakshmanan
